name: Lian Mian Bu Jue
source:
You lost your memory of nothing but a mundane day. But why do mysterious men keep jamming into your life, all of them pointing to the day you forgot? Find out a hypnosis clinic receptionist's memory of an insignificant day in this BL visual novel.

This is part II of "The Mind Deceivers" Trilogy.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2515530/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你失去了一切的记忆，除了平凡的一天。但为什么神秘的男人不断闯入你的生活，他们都指向你忘记的那一天？在这部BL视觉小说中找出催眠诊所接待员对一个微不足道的一天的记忆。

这是“心灵欺骗者”三部曲的第二部分。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2515530/]Steam[/url]]
